span.p:
score each tile by the
NEARER of camera and probe
(camera pushed along the
view direction), out of
frustum demoted x3.0, kept

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 250px; text-align: center;

span.p:
fill max_instances (default
4,000,000) best score first,
keep set widened x1.30 against
thrash, at most 6 tile
fetches in flight

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 250px; text-align: center;

span.p:
a resident tile is its own
InstancedMesh, a real cull
unit - an evicted tile becomes
an impostor box drawn from
the index z-range

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5;

span.p: tiled_exporter.write_tiled_payload() - one band resident, nothing thinned or capped

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 250px; text-align: center;

span.p:
per tile row, searchsorted
on _keys gives a contiguous
column slice, hence a
contiguous interval slice

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 250px; text-align: center;

span.p:
bucket the band by tile_iy
with a stable sort, then pack
32-byte records: f32 xyz,
f32 sizes, u8 rgb, u8 class

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 250px; text-align: center;

span.p:
append tile-contiguous and
note, per tile, its metric
AABB and its byte offset
and record count

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 250px; text-align: center;

span.p:
ColumnStore, memory-mapped
bias-shifted packed keys, so
canonical order IS ascending
(ix, iy) - a tile row is a slice

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 250px; text-align: center;

span.p:
.bin - every interval,
byte layout spatial. Under
64 MB it is base64-inlined
in the .html; above it,
serve_voxel_html answers
Range requests with 206

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 250px; text-align: center;

span.p:
.idx.json - per tile the
AABB, byte offset, count
and the class table
